pages.text: Arcanist's Garb can be rewoven with what the Hollow's creatures leave behind. Use a $(l)Smithing Table$(): the material goes in the first slot, the garment in the second, the extra in the third.$(br2)Each piece keeps its garb bonus, still counts toward the full set, keeps its enchantments, and gains something new.

pages.title: Wispwoven Hood
pages.text: Wisp Essence + Arcanist's Hood + Glowstone Dust. You see in the dark.

pages.title: Shadeweave Robe
pages.text: Shade Cloth + Arcanist's Robe + Ender Pearl. You vanish while sneaking.

pages.title: Lurkerscale Leggings
pages.text: Lurker Scale + Arcanist's Leggings + Prismarine Shard. Breathe and swim freely underwater.

pages.title: Mothsilk Boots
pages.text: Moth Wing Dust + Arcanist's Boots + Antler Shard. You jump higher and never take fall damage.
